findings.finding: Global CoE/FinOps/catalogue data lacks complete tenant/workspace ownership and scoped queries
findings.evidence: services/backend_core/enterprise_os/models.py: AICoEProject, AIPolicy, AIRisk, AITraining, CostRecord, Integration; router.py: coe_projects, coe_policies, coe_risks, coe_training, finops_usage
findings.action: Design and migrate ownership for legacy rows; scope reads/writes and test two tenants. No exception or multi-tenant production approval granted.

findings.finding: Shared HTTP rate limiter permits requests after a Redis pipeline failure and retains unbounded fallback identities
findings.action: Bound fallback storage and enforce an explicit production failure policy; add Redis outage/load acceptance. Separate tenant_limiter.py already defaults fail-closed.

findings.finding: Some Phase 5 connector errors still return raw exception text
findings.action: Sanitize provider error responses and logs across all additional connectors; the primary real_connectors.py helpers are already sanitized.

findings.finding: Image tags and model names are not fully pinned to verified immutable digests/revisions
findings.action: Resolve/pin image and model provenance on the build host, generate full image SBOM and scan/sign the actual artifacts.

scope: Code review findings; no production penetration test or formal risk waiver.
